subject: Mobile Development
title: Nokia's Fatal Hesitation
description: A short lesson to help you apply Nokia's Fatal Hesitation.

hook.text: In 2007, Nokia engineers had a working touchscreen prototype. Management shelved it.

buildup.text: Nokia's leadership believed physical keyboards would remain dominant for years.

discovery.text: Internal memos show engineers warned that the iPhone would destroy their market position.

twist.text: Nokia partnered with Microsoft for Windows Phone in 2011. It was too little, too late.

climax.text: Microsoft bought Nokia's phone business in 2014, then wrote off the entire $7.2 billion deal.

punchline.text: Nokia saw the future and chose not to build it.

quiz.question: What did Nokia's engineers have before the iPhone launch?
